ideas.pitch: An offline-first, multilingual voice agent that provides localized maternal health guidance and vaccine tracking for rural health workers in low-connectivity regions.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing healthcare, offline-first, and low-resource AI solutions in rural communities as outlined in the Mozilla Human Scale AI Buildathon 2026 scope.
ideas.title: GramVani HealthSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits Mozilla's core vision of offline-first, multilingual, and community-centred AI for healthcare, aligning perfectly with the organizing foundation's explicit mandate.

ideas.pitch: A low-resource crop disease and soil deficiency detector running locally on edge hardware via quantized computer vision models, translating diagnosis into regional audio instructions.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing agriculture and low-resource AI solutions that are responsive to diverse societal needs as specified in the hackathon context.
ideas.title: Sahayak Krishi Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes resource-efficient edge AI that requires no cloud dependency, scoring high on Mozilla's human-scale, privacy-first, and low-resource technical ethos.

ideas.pitch: An accessible, synchronous classroom learning tool that generates simplified regional language concept maps and audio summaries for students with diverse learning abilities.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing education and accessibility challenges through inclusive open AI solutions as outlined in the buildathon guidelines.
ideas.title: Bhasha Shikshak AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines accessibility features with multilingual educational tools, mimicking past winning accessibility architectures while fitting the open-source Mozilla ethos.

ideas.pitch: An interactive legal and wage rights navigation agent that translates complex municipal labor laws into regional voice queries and logs local grievance data securely.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing worker rights and civic services challenges under the community-centred AI track of the buildathon.
ideas.title: Mazdoor Adhikar Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on worker rights and civic accountability—an underrepresented theme in most hackathons that directly answers Mozilla's call for social impact and human-scale dignity.

ideas.pitch: An offline-capable community mapping tool that assesses urban infrastructure and public transit accessibility via crowdsourced sensor reports and localized AI routing.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing community development and accessibility challenges through open, inclusive technology as mandated by the hackathon themes.
ideas.title: Sugamya Marg
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a working prototype with a demonstrable live demo mapping local physical barriers, matching the judges' preference for working community-impact software.
